name: Klausen (Italy)
description: Hanging white banner charged in its lower part with the municipal arms of Klausen (a white key on red).
history: Municipal flag of Klausen, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Klausen arms — white key on red
